title: 生涯スポーツ演習（ソフトボール）
subtitle: Academic Exercises on Lifelong Sports
courseType: Student and Study Skills Courses ProgramCharacter Building CoursesLifelong Sports
educationalGoal:
Through learning activities for futsal, students will:
 1)   Understand the pleasure derived from sports.
 2)   Acquire the knowledge and ability to practice various sports activities voluntarily through the PDCA cycle.
 3)   Learn the things that are needed for social/college life, such as observation of the rules, discipline, respect, a competitive spirit, leadership/followership abilities, responsibility, safety awareness, and communication skills.
advice:
This class aims to achieve the above-mentioned learning objectives through the learning of softball activities.
Specifically, students will learn the following:
1. An understanding of softball
(1) Game characteristics(2) Rules and equipment(3) Implementation
2. Learning fundamental softball skills
(1) Catch a throw(2) Catching a ground ball(3) Pitching(4) Batting
3. Learning applied skills in a softball game (teamwork)
(1) Teamwork among infielders(2) Teamwork between infielders and outfielders
4. Game implementation and learning of basic rules (referee practice)
Classes will be held once per week (100 minutes).
In practical classes, students should wear appropriate clothing such as sportswear, T-shirts, shorts, and outdoor shoes.
Students should aim to attend all classes highly motivated to learn.
Students should pay attention to their own health condition.
Students need to participate while actively showing willingness to learn fundamental skills
Students should be prepared with both indoor and outdoor shoes in the case of rainy weather.
Students should stay hydrated by making sure to bring adequate sports drinks on hot days.
requiredKnowledge: Prepared to learn a sports activity and understand safety.

activityGoals.body: Be able to express the importance of enjoying an active sports lifestyle throughout your lifetime.
Be able to learn the fundamental skills needed for futsal and use them in learning activities.
Be able to evaluate and explain your own situation and improvements in sports activities based on the PDCA cycle
Be able to understand the necessities for social life and implement them in learning activities.
Be able to express problems and make improvements that promote a healthy lifestyle by assessing your daily life.
Be able to understand safety management in sports and implement this understanding in learning activities.
